module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks against comparing a variable with multiple items, where
      # `Array#include?`, `Set#include?` or a `case` could be used instead
      # to avoid code repetition.
      # It accepts comparisons of multiple method calls to avoid unnecessary method calls
      # by default. It can be configured by `AllowMethodComparison` option.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b' || a == 'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if ['a', 'b', 'c'].include?(a)
      #
      #   VALUES = Set['a', 'b', 'c'].freeze
      #   # elsewhere...
      #   foo if VALUES.include?(a)
      #
      #   case foo
      #   when 'a', 'b', 'c' then foo
      #   # ...
      #   end
      #
      #   # accepted (but consider `case` as above)
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: true (default)
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: false
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo if [b.lightweight, b.heavyweight].include?(a)
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 2 (default)
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 3
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      class MultipleComparison < Base
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \
              'in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.'

        def on_or(node)
          return unless node

          ancestor = node.parent
          if ancestor && ancestor.type == :or
            return
          end

          cop_settings = cop_config
          allow_method_comparison = true
          comparisons_threshold = 2
          allow_key = 'AllowMethodComparison'
          threshold_key = 'ComparisonsThreshold'
          if cop_settings.key?(allow_key)
            allow_method_comparison = cop_settings[allow_key]
          else
            allow_method_comparison = true
          end
          if cop_settings.key?(threshold_key)
            comparisons_threshold = cop_settings[threshold_key]
          else
            comparisons_threshold = 2
          end

          equality_operators = YodaCondition::EQUALITY_OPERATORS
          noncommutative_operators = YodaCondition::NONCOMMUTATIVE_OPERATORS
          other_comparison_operators = %i[< > <= >= <=>]
          comparison_tree_valid = true
          variables = Set.new
          values = []
          worklist = []
          worklist << node

          while !worklist.empty?
            break unless comparison_tree_valid

            current = worklist.pop
            current_type = current.type
            if current_type == :or
              or_children = current.children
              left_child = or_children[0]
              right_child = or_children[1]
              if right_child
                worklist << right_child
              else
                comparison_tree_valid = false
              end
              if left_child
                worklist << left_child
              else
                comparison_tree_valid = false
              end
            elsif current_type == :send
              send_children = current.children
              method_name = send_children[1]
              first_argument = send_children[2]
              extra_argument = send_children[3]
              if extra_argument
                comparison_tree_valid = false
              elsif method_name == :==
                if first_argument.nil?
                  comparison_tree_valid = false
                elsif simple_double_comparison?(current)
                  next
                else
                  compared = simple_comparison?(current)
                  if compared
                    var = compared[0]
                    obj = compared[1]
                    skip_value = false
                    obj_is_call = false
                    comparable_operand = obj
                    obj_type = obj.type
                    if obj_type == :send
                      obj_is_call = true
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :csend
                      obj_is_call = true
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false

                    elsif obj_type == :erange

                    elsif obj_type == :const

                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :ivar
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :cvar
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :gvar
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :self
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :begin
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :kwbegin
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :block
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :super
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    elsif obj_type == :yield
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    else
                      obj_is_call = false
                      comparable_operand = obj
                      skip_value = false
                    end
                    if allow_method_comparison
                      if obj_is_call
                        skip_value = true
                      end
                    end
                    unless skip_value
                      variables << var
                      if variables.size > 1
                        next
                      end
                      values << comparable_operand
                    end
                  else
                    comparison_tree_valid = false
                  end
                end
              elsif equality_operators.include?(method_name)
                comparison_tree_valid = false
              elsif noncommutative_operators.include?(method_name)
                comparison_tree_valid = false
              elsif other_comparison_operators.include?(method_name)
                comparison_tree_valid = false
              else
                comparison_tree_valid = false
              end
            elsif current_type == :csend
              comparison_tree_valid = false
            elsif current_type == :and
              comparison_tree_valid = false
            elsif current_type == :begin
              comparison_tree_valid = false
            else
              comparison_tree_valid = false
            end
          end

          if comparison_tree_valid
            if variables.any?
              if values.size >= comparisons_threshold
                first_value = values.first
                last_value = values.last
                first_parent = first_value.parent
                last_parent = last_value.parent
                first_range = first_parent.source_range
                last_range = last_parent.source_range
                range_begin = first_range.begin
                range_end = last_range.end
                range = range_begin.join(range_end)
                variable = variables.first

                add_offense(range) do |corrector|
                  elements = values.map(&:source).join(', ')
                  prefer_method = "[#{elements}].include?(#{variable_name(variable)})"

                  corrector.replace(range, prefer_method)
                end
              end
            end
          end

        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_lhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $lvar :== $_)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_rhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_rhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $_ :== $lvar)
        PATTERN

        def simple_comparison?(node)
          if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs?(node)) ||
             (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs?(node))
            [var, obj]
          end
        end

        def variable_name(node)
          node.children[0]
        end
      end

            return if allow_method_comparison? && obj.call_type?

            variables << var
            return if variables.size > 1

            values << obj
          end

          [variables.first, values] if variables.any?
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def offense_range(values)
          values.first.parent.source_range.begin.join(values.last.parent.source_range.end)
        end

        def variable_name(node)
          node.children[0]
        end

        def nested_comparison?(node)
          if node.or_type?
            node.node_parts.all? { |node_part| comparison? node_part }
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def comparison?(node)
          !!simple_comparison(node) || nested_comparison?(node)
        end

        def simple_comparison(node)
          if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs(node)) || (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs(node))
            return if var.call_type? && !allow_method_comparison?

            [var, obj]
          end
        end

        def root_of_or_node(or_node)
          return or_node unless or_node.parent

          if or_node.parent.or_type?
            root_of_or_node(or_node.parent)
          else
            or_node
          end
        end

        def allow_method_comparison?
          cop_config.fetch('AllowMethodComparison', true)
        end

        def comparisons_threshold
          cop_config.fetch('ComparisonsThreshold', 2)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
